IC1: - Men [OR] and women age 65 years or older
IC2: - Current PD diagnosis [AND] with symptoms severity at Hoehn & Yahr (H&Y) stage 1-4 based on an expert assessment (movement disorders neurologist report [OR] or telemedicine evaluation)
IC3: - Willing [AND] and able to continue in follow-up for at least 2 years
